Add an in-memory reservation ledger to src/reservations.mjs. Export createLedger(capacity), returning reserve(id, count), release(id), and snapshot(). Capacity and reservation counts must be positive integers. reserve returns true when there is capacity, false otherwise. Repeating an existing id and the same count succeeds without consuming capacity twice; reusing an id for another count throws. release returns whether a reservation existed. snapshot returns {capacity, available, reservations}, where reservations is an array of {id, count} in insertion order. Callers must not be able to mutate the ledger by modifying a snapshot. Reject empty reservation ids. Keep this module independent of persistence and network services.
